CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION docworks_private.confirmar_prueba()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  if new.email_confirmed_at is not null and new.raw_user_meta_data->>'docworks_registro' in ('trial_14_v1','trial_month_v1') then
    perform docworks_private.provisionar_prueba(new.id);
  end if;
  return new;
end; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION docworks_private.proteger_prueba()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  if old.es_prueba and auth.uid() is not null and not public.fn_es_super_admin(auth.uid()) then
    raise exception 'Solo DocWorks puede modificar la membresía de prueba';
  end if;
  return new;
end; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_documento_versiones_snapshot()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_version integer;
begin
  if tg_op = 'UPDATE'
     and (
       old.datos is distinct from new.datos
       or old.tipo is distinct from new.tipo
       or old.parent_id is distinct from new.parent_id
     ) then
    select coalesce(max(v.version), 0) + 1
      into v_version
      from public.documento_versiones v
     where v.operacion_id = old.id;

    insert into public.documento_versiones (
      inmobiliaria_id,
      operacion_id,
      version,
      tipo_documento,
      documento,
      creado_por
    )
    values (
      old.inmobiliaria_id,
      old.id,
      v_version,
      old.tipo,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'id', old.id,
        'tipo', old.tipo,
        'estado', old.estado,
        'parent_id', old.parent_id,
        'datos', old.datos,
        'creado_en', old.creado_en,
        'actualizado_en', old.actualizado_en,
        'actualizado_por', old.actualizado_por
      ),
      coalesce(new.actualizado_por, old.actualizado_por)
    );
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_es_admin(p_usuario_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select coalesce((select rol_base in ('dueno','admin') from usuarios where id = p_usuario_id and activo), false);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_es_super_admin(p_usuario_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select exists(select 1 from super_admins where user_id = p_usuario_id);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_invitaciones_pendientes_count(p_inmobiliaria_id uuid)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select count(*)::int from invitaciones
   where inmobiliaria_id = p_inmobiliaria_id and not usada and expira_en > now();
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_limite_usuarios(p_inmobiliaria_id uuid)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select coalesce((select s.limite_usuarios from docworks_private.seguimiento s where s.inmobiliaria_id=p_inmobiliaria_id),pl.limite_usuarios) from membresias m join planes pl on pl.id = m.plan_id
   where m.inmobiliaria_id = p_inmobiliaria_id;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_usuarios_activos_count(p_inmobiliaria_id uuid)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select count(*)::int from usuarios where inmobiliaria_id = p_inmobiliaria_id and activo;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.trg_auth_user_onboarding()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  perform public.fn_provisionar_usuario_por_email(new.email);
  return new;
end;
$function$
